content: Vercel CDN: responses cache on the shared edge keyed by URL. Cache-Control public s-maxage on a route that can return personalized data lets one user's response be served to another, or a guest response to be served to an authenticated user. Vercel will not cache when the request has an Authorization header or the response has private/no-cache/no-store. Correct pattern: personalized routes return 'private, no-store'; public routes may be cached, optionally partitioned by an explicit guest cache key; never rely on Vary: Cookie alone.
